paragraphs.text: Last Saturday was a warm, sunny day. My family went to Sugar Park. We carried a big basket of food.
paragraphs.translation: 上周六是个温暖晴朗的日子。我们一家人去了糖糖公园。我们带了一大篮子食物。

paragraphs.text: The park was full of happy people. Some children played games on the grass. A small band played sweet music nearby.
paragraphs.translation: 公园里满是快乐的人。一些孩子在草地上玩游戏。一支小乐队在附近演奏着甜甜的音乐。

paragraphs.text: Mom put a red cloth on the grass. We had sandwiches, apples and candy cakes. I ate two candy cakes very fast. My little brother ate three of them!
paragraphs.translation: 妈妈把一块红布铺在草地上。我们吃了三明治、苹果和糖果蛋糕。我很快就吃掉两块糖果蛋糕。我弟弟吃了三块！

paragraphs.text: After lunch, we played a fun game. Dad hid a golden candy in the flowers. Everyone looked for it with big smiles. My sister found it behind a small bush.
paragraphs.translation: 午饭后，我们玩了一个有趣的游戏。爸爸把一颗金色糖果藏在花丛里。大家都笑呵呵地去找。我妹妹在一小丛灌木后面找到了它。

paragraphs.text: We watched a kite show near the lake. Ten colorful kites flew high in the sky. One kite looked like a big pink cat.
paragraphs.translation: 我们在湖边看了一场风筝表演。十只彩色的风筝高高地飞在天上。有一只风筝看起来像一只粉色的大猫。

paragraphs.text: In the evening, we walked home slowly. I was tired but very happy. I want to go there again next year.
paragraphs.translation: 傍晚，我们慢慢地走回家。我很累，但非常开心。明年我还想再去那里。
